findings.description: AWS access key ID and secret access key are embedded in plain text in the EC2 user_data script. User data is readable by anyone with ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute permission and is stored in Terraform state, exposing long-lived static credentials.
No metadata_options block enforcing http_tokens = "required", so IMDSv1 remains enabled and an SSRF in the web application could retrieve instance credentials without authentication.
The instance does not specify root_block_device with encrypted = true, so the root EBS volume may store data unencrypted at rest.
The instance is launched in a subnet with map_public_ip_on_launch enabled and routed to an internet gateway, giving it a public IP and direct internet exposure alongside a wide-open security group.
The EBS volume is created without encrypted = true, so data written to the attached volume is stored unencrypted.
The snapshot is taken from an unencrypted volume and has no encryption or KMS key configured, leaving a persistent unencrypted copy of the data.
Ingress rule allows TCP port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing SSH administrative access to the entire internet and enabling brute-force and exploit attempts.

Port 80 is open to 0.0.0.0/0 serving unencrypted HTTP traffic, and the egress rule allows all protocols and ports to 0.0.0.0/0, providing an unrestricted data-exfiltration and command-and-control channel.
The S3 bucket receiving VPC flow logs has no server-side encryption configuration, so sensitive network audit logs are stored unencrypted.

findings.issue_category: missing public access block and access controls
findings.description: The flow log bucket has no public access block, bucket policy requiring TLS, versioning, or access logging, leaving audit data at risk of accidental public exposure or tampering.
map_public_ip_on_launch = true causes every instance launched in this subnet to receive a public IP, placing workloads directly on the internet rather than in a private network layer.
map_public_ip_on_launch = true causes every instance launched in this subnet to receive a public IP, removing the private network layer boundary.
